name: Mattes - Podcast
description: Deep, clear male voice. Ideal for audiobooks and podcast hosting.

name: Oswald - Kind & Gentle Grandpa
description: Warm & gentle grandfather voice with a soft, slightly weathered tone and a calm, unhurried pace. Every word feels like a cozy evening by the fireplace: kind, reassuring and full of lived experience. Ideal for bedtime stories, audiobooks, fairy tales, children’s content, heartfelt ads, commercials, documentaries and nostalgic storytelling. A loving, trustworthy presence that makes listeners feel safe and at home.

name: Azrak - Menacing Monster
description: A deep, dark creature voice – demonic, authoritative & imposing, with a rugged, terrifying tone. Think dark fantasy boss meets horror antagonist: guttural, dark & full of raw power for maximum cinematic dread. Heavy, resonant & beastly, delivers intense boss fights, creature monologues, and grounded, terrifying dialogue. Built for horror games, epic cutscenes, dark fantasy, and immersive real-time gaming. Voiced by Alex Vox.

name: Theo Thaler - iconic & fresh
description: Theo Thaler delivers professional, expressive voiceover performances for commercials, social media ads, and corporate videos—exceptionally consistent, flexibly customizable, and ready for immediate deployment.

name: Waldfried - Deep, Theatrical
description: A deep, resonant German male voice with a rich, authoritative tone and a theatrical storytelling style. Clear articulation, deliberate pacing, and expressive emphasis create a captivating, cinematic atmosphere. Ideal for audiobooks, fantasy narratives, historical documentaries, and dramatic voice-over performances.

name: Jan - Laid-back Storyteller
description: Relaxed, authentic, approachable. A natural conversational tone for social media, podcasts, and storytelling.

name: Piet Convo - Thoughtful & Unscripted
description: A grounded, natural male voice with a relaxed and authentic tone. Calm and thoughtful, speaking with easy conversational flow, subtle pauses, and genuine clarity. Striking the perfect balance between relaxed realism and clear authority, making every sentence feel real and unscripted. Ideal for German and English conversational content, explainers, podcasts, brand films, and immersive audio guides. Voice by Robert Ranger.

name: Snorre - Nervous & Eccentric
description: Fast-talking cartoon voice with a jittery, excitable tone and frantic humor. Try periods … for timid stutters and nervous chuckles. Perfect for online games, real-time applications and non-player characters (NPC) like comic goblins, quirky sidekicks, anxious gnomes, cowardly Vikings or funny cartoon villains. Fast, raspy and hyperactive delivery full of comical rants, high squeaks and spontaneous breath control. Love this gaming-voice? Try other character voices by Alex Vox.

name: Clay - Deep Thoughtful Storyteller
description: A deep, warm, and grounded voice with an authentic, thoughtful tone. Naturally relaxed and effortlessly conversational, speaking with a calm, quiet authority that feels completely real, never read. Clear, textured acoustic resonance brings emotional depth and cinematic realism to every narrative. Ideal for German and English brand films, documentaries, podcasts, commercials, and immersive storytelling that require genuine human connection and calm strength. Voiced by Robert Ranger.
